Geographies Served Programs Sai Sankalp Nursery and Primary School Sai Sankalp Nursery and Primary School, located in Arasankazhani Village, has been providing free English medium education to underprivileged children in and around Semmenchery slum tenements since year 2006. Our school is a nursery and primary school currently serving about 209 children. The school provides a safe, caring and nourishing learning environment for proper upbringing of socially & economically disadvantaged children and to empower them to join the competitive world with inner strength and confidence. Impact Metrics Number and % of Children Completing Basic Learning Objectives (Foundational Literacy, Foundational Numeracy) Year-wise Metrics Average Attendance of Children Year-wise Metrics % and Number of Children Participating in Atleast Two Extra Curricular Activities Year-wise Metrics Theory of Change Due to commercialization of education, there is total degradation of the human values in the society. Also, the quality of education imparted in most of the present day schools leaves much to be desired. Our aim is not only to give them education but also to evolve a life care model for bringing up children into disciplined, socially responsible and vibrant individuals. --> Milestones & Track Record The trust has grown from serving 32 children in 2006 to 217 children in recent years, expanding its educational services from LKG to Class V. --> --> Leadership Team Aparna Ganapathi Trustee Sangeetha Rajappa Trustee Sairamkumar Jayaraman Trustee Rajashree Natarajan Trustee Kannan Ramari Founder Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength 5 Organization Structure Yes M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAFTS3141M Registration Number 851/4/2002 CSR Form 1 CSR00021867 VO ID / Darpan ID TN/2017/0175566 --> 80G AAFTS3141MF20231 12A AAFTS3141ME20221 FCRA 075820421 About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 2003 Demographies Served Children --> Impact Starting with just 32 children in June 2006, the Sai Sankalp Nursery & Primary School now serves about 217 children from LKG to Class V, offering a safe, caring, and nourishing learning environment. Vision and Mission Vision : To carry out public charitable objects aimed at economic and intellectual uplift of the underprivileged in rural area irrespective of caste, community, color or race. Mission : To provide high quality holistic education to socially & economically disadvantaged and empower them to join the competitive world with inner strength and confidence through our Projects (Sai Sankalp Nursery and Primary School and Rise and Shine Scholarships).
